Could you create an issue and attach a sample capture for this? I especially have questions about the new statistics menu and dialog. Why does it need to be a submenu? Will other dialogs be added to that in the future?

I will write an issue with some motivating points behind these changes.
The reason for the submenu is to allow for more statistics from related protocols to be added without clutter in the main menu.

I assumed as much of the submenu. It's just, I would rather see the motivation before hand, before adding that stuff. 

Btw, read up on LTP. I am an industrial networking guy and found a loot of similarities. You guys/gals play around with a pretty cool protocol/application ;-)
The motivational checklist is in #18143 now.
Resolving the thread for now, but the rebase has to happen before the merge can go through

commits_data.message:
LTP: Enhance with generated items, sequence analysis, and statistics

This change adds computed values for reports, sequence analysis between
segments, conversation and endpoint taps, and a new statistics menu
and dialog.
